citations.description: Ticket show_ticket result: status=in_progress, comments=[] — no live verification attestation recorded.

findings.criterion: Verified live against Jira with a probe ticket, which is then removed from both Jira and rebar.
findings.detail: This criterion is untagged (hence codebase-verifiable by default) but is inherently operational — it requires a live Jira probe run. The ticket has no comments and no recorded attestation of any live verification. The ticket status is still 'in_progress' with an empty comments array, so there is no evidence this was performed.
findings.remediation: Tag this criterion `[operator-attested]` and record a ticket comment naming: the probe ticket key (Jira + rebar IDs), the observed Jira rendering (single paragraph, no per-line breaks), and the date/time it was created and removed from both systems.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
